_about: THE NEW ACT-ONE ENEMIES (FACTIONS 11/3, VAMILY rule 302, Paolo 11/2: 'more content... new enemies, new graphics, the whole package'; laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_THE_BEASTS_ARE_LAB_MADE_AND_THE_BESTIARY_FLOOR_9_29_26.md: at least 12 factions and ~75 enemy types, every Battle Brothers archetype keeps its lesson in a Bohemia skin, act one feels medieval). ONE FILE A MODDER CAN EDIT: every row is a whole enemy type (its name on the board, its Battle Brothers lesson, the wiki row it rides on, its stats, its gear, its brain, its look), every brain is a list of behaviours the fight already reads or one of the eight new ones below, every faction is a make-up by phase, and the road table says where and when each faction walks. The fight folds this file into its own tables when it deals a board (slices/BOHEMIA_FIGHT.html ownEnemies); nothing here is typed twice. Stats are the wiki row's own numbers unless a row's 'stats' says otherwise, and every such change carries its why. Every word is draft:true (WORDS owns them); every felt number is TUNING's to move (tuned:false).
source: records/target/bb/enemies.json (each row's 'from' is a wiki unit row, its page cited there); reference/library/grok/wiki/PAGES_ALL.tar.gz for each behaviour's page

house.name: The House
house.lesson: A formation. Shields in front, hooks behind them, crossbows behind that. Break the wall or go round it.

watch.name: The Block Watch
watch.lesson: Neighbors with pitchforks. Hurt one and he runs. Their captain calls them back, so drop him first.

keepers.name: The Keepers
keepers.lesson: Desert people. They throw an axe as you close, and one of them never stops.

water.name: The Water People
water.lesson: You do not see them until they are on you. Their needles slow you down for three turns.

coyotes.name: Coyotes
coyotes.lesson: They never fight a man standing up. They go for the hurt one and eat the dead. Leave nobody on the field.

lions.name: A Mountain Lion
lions.lesson: You do not see it until it is on the man walking alone. Then he is pinned. Walk together.

hogs.name: Hogs
hogs.lesson: They come straight in and open your legs. A man who bleeds, step him back.

camels.name: Camels
camels.lesson: Never stand next to one. It kicks every way at once. Shoot it from two tiles and it runs.

bulls.name: A Bull
bulls.lesson: It runs in a straight line and cannot turn. Step off the line, or stand behind something.

rows.name: House Shield
rows.lesson_bb: THE SHIELD WALL (Battle Brothers' Footman: 'Shieldwall' on every shield, bb_all/1780_Shieldwall (20 fatigue).txt)
rows.lesson: He locks his shield with the men beside him. Each one in the wall makes the others harder to hit. Hit the end of the line, or make him swing.

stats.why: act one (the perks: the shield, nothing else; the wiki's footman carries every mastery, Battle Forged and Brawny): the wiki's footman is a mid-game soldier (70 skill, a kite shield, mail to 230); the House's first men are recruits with a car door for a shield (the wiki's wooden shield) and what a 2050 shop sells, so a conscript's skill and the low end of the armour. Measured: as the wiki's footman, two of them beat a new crew of three 13 times in 20

rows.name: House Hook
rows.lesson_bb: THE POLEARM BEHIND THE WALL (Battle Brothers' Billman: 'Hook', bb_all/1021_Hook (25 fatigue).txt: the target is pulled closer)
rows.lesson: He stands one step behind the shields and reaches over them. His hook drags your man off his line and into the wall.

stats.why: act one: the low half of the wiki's range

rows.name: House Crossbow
rows.lesson_bb: THE ARCHER LINE (Battle Brothers' Arbalester: shoot, reload, shoot, from behind the line)
rows.lesson: They stay back and all shoot the same man. Close the gap fast, or put cover between you.

rows.name: Neighbor
rows.lesson_bb: THE COWARD WHO RUNS (Battle Brothers' Armed Peasant: low resolve, the first to flee)
rows.lesson: A scared man with a pitchfork. Cut him once, hard, and he runs for home.

rows.name: Block Captain
rows.lesson_bb: THE LEADER WHO RALLIES (Battle Brothers' Militia Captain: 'Rally the Troops', bb_all/1634_Rally the Troops.txt; 'Captain', bb_all/0343_Captain.txt)
rows.lesson: He stays behind his neighbors and yells them back into the fight. Kill him and the ones who run keep running.

stats.why: act one: the low half of the wiki's range

rows.name: Feral
rows.lesson_bb: THE BERSERKER (Battle Brothers' Orc Berserker: 'Berserk', bb_all/0232_Berserk.txt: 4 AP back on a kill, once a turn)
rows.lesson: He runs straight at your weakest man and never breaks. Every kill gives him another swing. Stop him before he reaches your back line.

stats.why: a man, not an orc: the wiki's 250 hitpoints is the orc's body; ours is a big man on something, so a sergeant's hitpoints (the wiki's 100, plus a tenth), skins and furs for armour, and nothing scares him (he never wavers: that is the lesson)

rows.name: Keeper
rows.lesson_bb: THE SKIRMISHER WHO THROWS FIRST (Battle Brothers' Barbarian Thrall: throwing axes, then the cleaver)
rows.lesson: He throws an axe as you walk in, then pulls a cleaver. Do not stand in the open on the way to him.

rows.name: Cutter
rows.lesson_bb: THE AMBUSHER (Battle Brothers' nomads and goblin ambushers: they wait where you cannot see them)
rows.lesson: You cannot see him until he is two steps away or he hits you. Keep your men together.

rows.name: Needle
rows.lesson_bb: THE ONE WHO POISONS (Battle Brothers' Goblin Ambusher: 'Goblin Poison', bb_all/1576_Poisoned (Goblin) (Status Effect).txt: -1 AP, -10 initiative, -1 vision, 3 turns)
rows.lesson: The darts carry lab sedative. A hit takes a step off your man, slows him and blurs his eyes for three turns. Kill the needle before your best fighter gets tagged.

stats.why: a grown woman, not a goblin: the wiki's 40 hitpoints plus a quarter

rows.name: Coyote
rows.lesson_bb: THE ONE THAT EATS THE DEAD (Battle Brothers' Nachzehrer: 'Gruesome Feast: eats a dead body... heals', bb_all/0925_Gruesome Feast (25 fatigue).txt; its numbers the Wolf's, bb_all/2230_Wolf.txt)
rows.lesson: Coyotes never fight a man standing up. They circle to the hurt one, run when they are hurt, and a coyote beside a body eats and gets back up. Kill them fast and leave nobody lying there.

stats.why: a coyote is 10 to 18 kg, a third of the wolf the wiki's row is: its hitpoints and nerve about half; just as quick

beast.why: the wiki's plain Bite (15-35), not the wolf's: a small dog's jaw; a coyote cannot climb a wall or a ladder

rows.roams: the suburbs' edges and the dead golf courses, every wash; more at night
rows.real: Canis latrans, in every part of the valley today (Nevada Department of Wildlife)
rows.feed: The coyotes were here before the city and they will be here after it. They eat what the fights leave.

rows.name: Mountain Lion
rows.lesson_bb: THE ONE THAT GRABS AND HOLDS (Battle Brothers' Serpent: it drags a man and coils round him, bb_all/1757_Serpent.txt; the ambush of the nomads' cutthroat)
rows.lesson: You cannot see it until it is two tiles off or it jumps. It goes for the man on his own and pins him: he cannot move until he fights his way up or it dies. One good shot drops it. Walk together.

stats.why: a 55 to 70 kg cat, faster than the wiki's serpent and with no scales (armour 10, its hide); 110 hitpoints so a rifle's good shot drops it (Paolo 9/30: a beast is never a boss)

beast.why: the serpent's own bite (50-70): the neck bite a cougar kills with; a puma jumps 4.5 m straight up and walks a roof

rows.roams: the mountain (the Spring Mountains: Mount Charleston, Red Rock's cliffs) and the hills' edges at night
rows.real: Puma concolor, resident in the Spring Mountains (Nevada Department of Wildlife)
rows.feed: Nothing let the lions out. They came down off Mount Charleston after the lab's horses and camels did.

rows.name: Feral Hog
rows.lesson_bb: THE ONE THAT OPENS YOU UP (Battle Brothers' Hyena: 'Hyena Bite... causes Bleeding... if at least 6 hitpoints were lost', bb_all/1055_Hyena Bite (6 fatigue).txt)
rows.lesson: Hogs come straight at the nearest man, low and fast, and the tusks open his legs: every hit that draws blood bleeds 5 a turn for 2 turns. Their shoulders are armoured. Step a bleeding man back.

stats.why: a boar is 60 to 150 kg and carries a cartilage shield up to 5 cm thick over its shoulders (armour 40 on the body); it does not quit (resolve 70, the hyena's 50 plus)

beast.why: the hyena's own bite (20-35, all of it on the armour) as the tusk; a pig cannot climb

rows.roams: only where there is water: the Las Vegas Wash, the wetlands, the lake shore, the dam
rows.real: Sus scrofa: farm pigs go wild in two generations; a pig cannot sweat and dies in the open desert in summer without a wallow
rows.feed: The pig farm north of town fed on the Strip's leftovers for fifty years. When the trucks stopped, the pigs walked to the Wash.

rows.name: Camelops
rows.lesson_bb: THE ONE THAT SWEEPS ROUND IT (Battle Brothers' Unhold: 'Sweep... can hit up to 3 targets next to each other... knockback', bb_all/1906_Sweep (20 fatigue).txt)
rows.lesson: A camel kicks with any leg, any way. One kick hits every man beside it and knocks each a tile back. It is not looking for a fight: hurt it and it runs. Shoot it from two tiles, never stand next to it.

stats.why: a 700 to 900 kg grazer, not a giant: two thirds of the unhold's hitpoints, no regeneration (a camel does not heal in a fight), and the nerve of prey (resolve 40)

beast.why: the unhold's Sweep (40-80) as the kick; a camel cannot climb

rows.roams: the open desert north of town: Tule Springs and Gypsum Cave, where the lab was, and the springs
rows.real: Camelops hesternus: Tule Springs bone; its DNA read from Yukon bone in 2015 (Heintzman et al.), a sister of the living camels; a dromedary surrogate
rows.feed: The lab at Tule Springs made them from the bones in the wash. They were the first thing to walk out when the power went.

rows.name: Feral Bull
rows.lesson_bb: THE ONE THAT CHARGES (Battle Brothers' Ijirok: 'Gore... has knockback and staggers the target on hit (a range of 3 to 6 tiles)', bb_all/0890_Gore (20 fatigue).txt)
rows.lesson: A bull puts its head down and runs at a man two to four tiles off in a straight line. If it lands, he goes flat and loses his next turn. It cannot turn: step off its line, or keep a wall or a man between you.

stats.why: an 800 kg bull: the unhold's weight without its regeneration; it does not run (resolve 90)

beast.why: the unhold's Sweep (40-80) as the horns, the charge its own (numbers.charge); a bull cannot climb

rows.roams: the open desert and the dead farms and fields, where the springs are
rows.real: Bos taurus: range cattle have run loose without an owner on Gold Butte, Clark County, for decades (the cattle the BLM tried to round up in 2014)
rows.feed: Gold Butte had wild cattle long before the crash. Now nobody counts them, and the bulls come down to the springs.

shieldwall.quote: Doubles Melee Defense and Ranged Defense shield stats for 1 turn (including the Shield Expert perk bonus). Grants additional +5 Melee Defense and +5 Ranged Defense for each adjacent ally using the Shieldwall

hooker.quote: +10% chance to hit, target is pulled closer to user

volley.quote: the backline of the Noble House line; FACTIONS: they all shoot the man the first bolt hit

coward.quote: the wiki's 35 resolve; FACTIONS: under half his hitpoints he runs, once

rallier.quote: Rally the Troops; FACTIONS: he calls a man back the moment he wavers, not only when he breaks

berserker.quote: Once per turn, upon killing an enemy, 4 Action Points are immediately regained

thrower.quote: the thrall's bundle of throwing axes, then the cleaver

ambusher.quote: FACTIONS: unseen until a man of yours stands within lurk.seen_within tiles or he strikes

scavenger.quote: Eats a dead body, grows in size (if possible), improves its morale, removes all injuries and heals; FACTIONS: a coyote beside a body eats while it is hurt; under a third of its hitpoints it runs, once

stalker.quote: FACTIONS: unseen until a man of yours is lurk.seen_within tiles off or it strikes; while unseen it moves only to a tile it can spring from this turn, else it lies still; it goes round for the weakest; the man it lands on is pinned (the net's rule) until he gets up or it is gone

sounder.quote: causes Bleeding for 5 dmg per turn... if at least 6 hitpoints were lost from the attack. Bleeding lasts 2 turns.

kicker.quote: Sweep does knockback, will stagger the target, can hit up to 3 targets next to each other; FACTIONS: a camel's kick reaches every man beside it, and under half its hitpoints it runs

charger.quote: Gore... has knockback and staggers the target on hit (has a range of 3 to 6 tiles)

shieldwall.quote: 4 AP, 20 fatigue; doubles the shield's defences for a turn; +5 for each adjacent ally using it. near_tiles is ours: he raises it when a foe is that close

hook.quote: 6 AP, 25 fatigue, +10% chance to hit, target is pulled closer to user; target_fatigue is ours (the page's number is cut off in the library)

lurk.quote: he shows when a man of yours is two tiles away, or the moment he strikes; wait_rounds (FIVE MORE BEASTS): the lion lies still that many of its turns waiting for a man to come within its spring, then stalks in

gash.quote: Bleeding for 5 dmg per turn on Hyenas... if at least 6 hitpoints were lost from the attack. Bleeding lasts 2 turns.

kick.quote: the Sweep's own 4 AP and 20 fatigue (beast_attacks.json sweep_20); FACTIONS: every man beside it, not three, because a camel kicks with any leg

charge.quote: Gore: 6 AP, 20 fatigue, knockback, staggers, a range of 3 to 6 tiles; FACTIONS: 2 to 4 of ours (a tile is a house), +10 to hit for the run (ours, draft)

feed.quote: Gruesome Feast: 6 AP, 25 fatigue; eats a dead body... heals; FACTIONS: 25 hitpoints a bite, two bites a body (ours, draft)

count_scale_beasts_why: a coyote pack is as many as his crew; a mountain lion hunts alone (one, two at eight or more); a hog sounder is 2 to 4 against a new crew (0.8 lost 9 of 10 to a crew of 6, the new-enemies gate's SIZED TO THE CREW, measured 11/3); a camel herd is a few; a bull is one, two at a big crew (FACTIONS 11/3, draft, TUNING's to move)

road.why: Paolo: 'Battle Brothers... how many groups are moving around at a certain time... way more'; enemies are never forced (a party you can see and avoid). A roaming party takes its faction from the act (by_act, added to COMBAT's road_factions), from the ground it walks (the faction that holds that ground in records/target/bb/factions.json walks there district_mult times as often) and from the hour (night).
road.night_why: the block watch goes home after dark; the water people and the keepers move at night (draft). FIVE MORE BEASTS: coyotes and lions hunt at night (a puma is most active from dusk to dawn); hogs go night-active in the heat; camels bed down
